speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: MOM seeks to help Singaporeans take on good jobs, build fulfilling careers, enjoy sustained increases in real incomes and have a more secure retirement.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: In doing so, we support the goal of building a nation of opportunity and a society that cares for its people.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We have a more educated generation with diverse aspirations and needs.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We have an ageing population with Baby Boomers retiring in increasing numbers over the next decade.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We face a volatile global economy, keener competition and faster technological change.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: Even as we reap the benefits of growth, we must be inclusive in our approach so as to build a society that cares.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: MOM will work closely with the other Government agencies and our tripartite partners to strengthen the Singaporean Core in the workforce and ensure Singaporeans of all ages have fair opportunities for leadership development and growth.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: MOM will help companies become more manpower-lean and strengthen their Singaporean Core in all major sectors of the economy.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We will support employers to redesign jobs, processes and workplaces to fully tap on the experience and contributions of all workers, especially our mature workers.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: To maximise their full potential, we will enable Singaporeans of all ages to pursue good jobs and build fulfilling careers.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: As the economy restructures, we will help Singaporeans, especially those in mid-careers, to adapt and remain employable.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We will enhance our employment support to prepare our workers and minimise potential job-skill mismatch.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We will work to ensure that Singaporean workers are fairly considered by employers when hiring and have fair opportunities for leadership development and growth at all levels.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: Quality growth should lead to better jobs and higher incomes for all.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We will also expand our suite of dispute management services for workers and employers.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We will step up efforts with our tripartite partners to enhance Workplace Safety and Health.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We will strive for a culture of prevention to safeguard the well-being of our workers in safer workplaces.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We will also enhance protection of injured workers to facilitate their return to work.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We will pay special attention and care to the older and lower-wage workers, by 	Page: 44 helping them achieve higher wages through better skills and improved productivity.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We want all workers to take pride in their work and all employers to value their workers.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We will work with tripartite partners to promote progressive HR practices, invest in human capital and create workplaces where workers in all jobs are respected and valued.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We have accepted several recommendations from the CPF Advisory Panel which aimed to improve the CPF system.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: The Panel comprised experts and community leaders and took into consideration feedback from citizens.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We will work towards the smooth implementation of these recommendations.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We can only achieve and sustain better jobs, higher incomes and financial security for all if employers, unions, workers, Government agencies and the community at large work in unity.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: Together, we can instil pride and confidence in co-creating our desired future of a better workforce and progressive workplaces for Singaporeans and Singapore.
